last_completed_unit.target: Cargo package.build=false automatic build-script discovery suppression
last_completed_unit.finding: The official Cargo manifest reference states that package.build defaults to build.rs and build=false disables automatic detection of the build script. This validates only the narrow manifest-level mechanism for suppressing automatic build.rs discovery in a package copy whose own manifest sets build=false.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Cargo package.build field semantics for default build.rs discovery and build=false suppression; documentation-only, no Cargo execution.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Specific-crate correctness without its build script, package.links compatibility, native/generated artifacts, alternate-source preparation, specific [patch] compatibility, actual compilation, or end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main freshness checks, and exactly one official Cargo documentation surface: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html#the-build-field.
scope_guard: Do not generalize build=false into proof that arbitrary build scripts are optional or that disabling one preserves package correctness.
